title: ABOUT GIRDER
notes: Brand-authored history. States that GIRDER Bicycle Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2015, introduced the British bicycle brand GIRDER and handles design, R&D and sales; positions products in the CNY 5,000–20,000 range. Claims the brand dates back to the 1977 founding of the Edinburgh Bicycle Co-operative, that partners in Manchester created the GIRDER brand, and that authorization to enter China succeeded in 2014. These origin and licensing claims are company-reported and were not independently corroborated. The HTTPS certificate had expired on access; the page was read over HTTP.
